notes: Walkers (docs/plans/unit-movement.md, Phase 4; the walker experiment, docs/plans/placeholder-art.md, Phase 6). The off-road walkers' hand-made art has the four axis directions; these entries add the diagonals it lacks, N, S and E rendered (W mirrored from E), into each hand-made def's own frame (its draw_size and iso_offset: 'frame'), with its frame counts and timings. Sync adds only these anim sets to the hand-made defs. New units are Blender's in every direction.

entries.notes: The settler: a family walking to its new home.
The peasant, a lumberyard harvester off the road.
The medic, on a call to a sick house.
The fire watcher, on a call to a fire (the guard in red).
The trader, a caravan from a land partner (the vendor in indigo).
The dog that wanders from the houses.
The water buffalo that wanders from the farms.
